title: Bugs Bunny with Carrot and Fruit
description: A large central Bugs Bunny smiles widely at the viewer while giving a thumbs up with one hand and holding a large carrot with the other, his big foot raised toward the camera. Many smaller Bugs Bunny characters in different costumes and poses surround him against a colorful striped background filled with oranges, tomatoes, and other round fruits and balls.
